parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: The outside frame of the trash can is made of stainless steel, providing structural support and durability. It is cylindrical and forms the outer shell of the trash can.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the container and cover, maintaining the shape and stability of the trash can.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: The cover is a circular lid made of plastic, designed to close the top of the trash can.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and keeps the contents concealed. It can be opened or closed manually or via a pedal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or lifts open around a hinge or pivot point.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container is the inner bucket of the trash can, made of plastic and designed to hold waste materials.
parts.Functional_description: It collects and contains trash, and can be removed for emptying and cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted out of the frame for disposal and cleaning purposes.
